name: superpowers-strigov-ver
description: Personal fork of superpowers for strigov: multi-model dev orchestrator with a pinned model + effort per role — Sonnet medium main thread orchestrates (triage, dispatching, polling, git); an Opus xhigh subagent writes the plan and Opus high applies its authorized revisions; Codex GPT-6 Astra xhigh reviews the plan (loop cap=4, fresh task each round, --effort ultra strictly user-initiated); Codex GPT-6 Luna max implements with GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh as reasoning escalation and Opus high as BLOCKED diagnosis; Opus high reviews each phase (xhigh on SECURITY/DATA_LOSS phases and in round 4), then Codex Astra high runs a control review on the diff (fused loop cap=4). Reviewers consume a pre-baked review package (bin/review-package) and implementers report to files; a final whole-branch Opus xhigh review (Astra xhigh fallback) gates plan completion (cap=2). Sonnet medium verification gate (lint/typecheck/affected tests) runs before every review round; multi-round reviews are consolidated into docs/reviews/ by a synthesis step. Codex resumes are thread-addressed via the vendored companion's --resume-task extension. Plans are written to docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md with YAML frontmatter for cross-session resume. Auto-commits on clean review. Routes trivial edits to Sonnet quickfix subagent. Plus codex-invocation recipe (incl. an ad-hoc second-opinion template), architecture-memory (ARCHI.md), and selected upstream skills (brainstorming with Opus spec writer + Astra spec review, writing-plans, systematic-debugging, TDD, worktrees, verification-before-completion, finishing-a-development-branch, code-review flow, writing-skills, dispatching-parallel-agents).
